newsitem.title: USA: Innkeepers starts 8.5 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Innkeepers starts 8.5 mln shr offering.

text.p: Innkeepers USA Trust said Monday said it was selling 8.5 million shares in a public stock offering.
The real estate investment trust said underwriters have an additional over-allotment option of 1.275 million shares.
Trust officials were not immediately available for comment, but a spokeswoman said the offering would likely be at market price. Innkeepers' stock traded at 13-7/8 Monday, down 3/8.
The trust had about 23.6 million shares outstanding in first quarter.
The trust said the managing underwriters for the offering are Lehman Brothers Inc Montgomery Securities, Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Everen Securities Inc and Salomon Brothers Inc.
